title: Pickle Ball Rocks
lyrics:
[Verse]
Pickleball rocks everywhere
I've got rocks in my pockets and rocks in the stairs
'Cause pickleball rocks everywhere

[Chorus]
Me and my paddle
Pickle rocks
Pickle rocks

[Post-Chorus]
Ah-dah-dah-dah
S-s-s-s-that
What's that?
Ah
It's that pickleball rocks sound
Spreading across the land

[Verse]
Lawn bowls are so last week
But still fun in the sun
Pickleball rocks everywhere
I've got rocks in my pockets and rocks in the stairs
'Cause pickleball rocks everywhere

Pickle rocks

[Post-Chorus]

S-s-s-s-that

Ah
It's that pickleball rocks sound
